name: kettlebell resistance band full squat from deficit
description: A deep squat from a raised platform with a band for added resistance, training the legs and glutes.
instructions: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.
